source_roles.original_input: Original training-labeled image cell_00944.png is a real 512x512 RGB microscopy patch; no test input is retained.
source_roles.supplied_helper: Its matching cell_00944_label.tiff is a source training annotation (36 nonzero instance IDs), never an answer to a held-out test case. ReX staging also exposes labeled public train and unlabeled public test images.
source_roles.answer_owned_output: submission.csv with image_id,predicted_mask_path and per-case instance mask; no saved prediction here.
source_roles.private_reference: ReX prepared private test labels and grading CSV; none retained. The original label sample is training help, not test truth.
source_roles.evaluator: Pinned grade.py computes per-case instance F1 at IoU thresholds 0.5..0.9, with boundary removal and large-image tiling.

contract.prep: Requires Training-labeled, Tuning, Testing original directories; combines 1000 Training-labeled + 101 Tuning image-label pairs, prefixes tuning IDs, sorted 80/20 split random_state=42. Original Testing and unlabeled archives are downloaded/extracted but not copied into prepared public/test by pinned prepare.py.
contract.mask_semantics: 0 background; positive integer IDs designate separate cells
contract.grader: Hungarian instance matching at IoU 0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9; excludes cells touching 2-pixel boundary; at least 25 million-pixel masks tiled in 2000x2000 ROIs. Resizes mismatched prediction shape nearest neighbor. Overall is mean leaderboard position if leaderboard exists, else -mean F1@0.5. Runtime described by challenge but not measured by pinned grade.py.
